name: pc2-target
context: After MCC-4, free-return splash was 152/155 GET Indian Ocean. Consumables and recovery argued against staying, against DPS-to-depletion, and for a PC+2 burn to 142 GET Pacific.
chose: Burn PC+2. Splash 142 GET in the Pacific. Do not stay on 152/155. Do not deplete the DPS.
consequences: free-return is superseded by pc2-return. Indian Ocean recovery is abandoned.
